author: Mortaleaf
body:
Username : Mortaleaf

Ban Reason : Hack - Flying

Why I should be Unbanned : I don't use Hacks. Period. It is unfair to all players to try to gain an advantage against others.
I think I was a mistake. Usually every time I join the server it lags for a few seconds and I fly when I hold space. Due to this reason I believe I was accidentally thought to be used as a hack. 

Thank You for your Time, Admins.

title: Appealing an Infraction

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

First off, I know you are lying. The evidence given here is irrefutable proof that you were hacking. You also mentioned that you only lag when you join the server. In this case, you were playing a game, and it gave me a clear indication that you hadn't recently "joined" the server. 

Please do not lie in appeals, as they will only lower your chances of getting appealed. 
This appeal is denied. 

Sincere ly,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator
